representativeSnapshot.kind: checkpoint-pinned legacy snapshot containing every booking recipient shape

rowCountQueries: Count booking_requests grouped by recipient_type and nullability of artist, venue, and organization recipient identifiers
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: No rows are updated; the pinned migration replaces one recipient validation constraint

execution.resumeStrategy: Confirm the checkpoint checksum and resulting constraint definition before any additive repair
execution.idempotency: The named constraint is dropped conditionally and recreated to one deterministic definition

quarantine.strategy: Preflight any invalid historical recipient shapes for reviewed repair; never guess a recipient account

constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Verify all legitimate recipient types pass, invalid mixed or missing targets fail, and the immutable file checksum matches the checkpoint

recovery.rollback: Disable affected booking mutations and apply a reviewed forward constraint repair after quarantining invalid rows
recovery.forwardFix: Add a NOT VALID replacement, repair quarantined data, validate, then remove the prior constraint additively

queries: Inspect the constraint definition and validate recipient-shape counts and direct invalid insert rejection
